clock: Corrected epoch = latest valid SNTP estimate (pure-Python client, raw packets retained; >=2 hosts, one half-delay<=20 ms, intervals agree, residual half-width<=50 ms, |offset|<=2 s) extrapolated by monotonic time, valid <=360 s. Gate: valid estimate <=360 s old at decision and endpoint. Wall steps logged, audit-only. Raw wall times retained.

cohort_rules.eligibility: binary Yes/No, 2 tokens, description, active, not closed, acceptingOrders, enableOrderBook, single posed resolution row, one contract per event
cohort_rules.excluded: 1231 archive-protected IDs (incl. 470 V4), 60 May cohort IDs, 40 June new-identity IDs

emission: Decision durably written by grid+30 s (corrected time) else missed/abstained; endpoint receipt at +120 s with 30 s grace.
evaluation: Once-only after window close + audit + consumption receipt. Primary: matched log loss hgb7 vs full_logit; also vs global_rate. Brier, AP, AUC, per-contract/date, nonoverlap, equal-contract LL, calibration, unknown-outcome bounds, contract-clustered bootstrap CI. Reporting floor: >=100 known, >=20 positives, >=20 negatives.
inputs: V03 14 source-time features, 120 s freshness, spread<=0.05, 250 ms source-lead cap, unchanged.
limits: No trading, news, or profit claim; one venue; dependent observations.
model: Unchanged V03 frozen bundle data/v7/source_time_study_20261026_v03/development/frozen_models.joblib (hgb7 selected; global_rate, market_rate, full_logit baselines). No fit.
readiness_gate: 60-min rehearsal: monotonic deadline reached, no schema/scope errors, all clock estimates re-validate from raw packets, corrected stamps reproduce, >=10 fully ready decisions across >=3 markets after warmup.
supersedes: forecast_runtime_20261026_v01 (frozen; fresh readiness FAILED on host-clock discipline). V01 artifacts unchanged.
target: Observed YES midpoint differs 30 minutes later (>1e-12); unknown endpoints stay unknown.
transport: Connected stream, pong<=35 s, 30 min since connect or REST cycle gap >120 s; all on corrected time.
window: Seven full UTC days starting the first full UTC date after a separate activation receipt; grids 00:30-23:25 every 5 min.
